caption:
The mountain bike race bib on the bars is a small detail, but the real effort happens in the silence between the gears. When you are deep in the forest, the trail doesn't care about your time or your training plan. It only cares about your rhythm. Finding a pace that allows you to breathe with the climb instead of fighting it is the only way to reach the ridge. The forest is patient. If you learn to be the same, the hardest ascent becomes a conversation with the terrain.
